hooks.command: bash -c 'in=$(cat); q=$(printf "\047"); re="(^|[[:space:]\";|&(<>=/~])[.][^[:space:]\"]*[*?]"; gh="(^|[^[:alnum:]_])[Gg][Hh]([^[:alnum:]_]|$)"; case "$in" in *[Gg][Ii][Tt]*|*GUARD_*|*\\*|*"$q"*|*[!:,[]{*|*[[]*) ;; *) [[ "$in" =~ $re ]] || [[ "$in" =~ $gh ]] || exit 0 ;; esac; ( source "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/guard/node22.sh && printf "%s" "$in" | node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/guard/claude-pretool.mjs ); [ $? -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2'

bash -c 'in=$(cat); ( source "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/guard/node22.sh && printf "%s" "$in" | node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/guard/claude-edit-guard.mjs ); rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && exit 2; case "$in" in *[Gg][Ii][Tt]*|*[Gg][Uu][Aa][Rr][Dd]*|*[Ss][Ee][Tt][Uu][Pp]*|*[Ss][Ee][Tt][Tt][Ii][Nn][Gg][Ss]*) exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0'
